payload.summary: Post-merge cleanup for PR #350, run in --defer-commit mode from the main-context convergence sync point, so this phase staged its output and made no commit of its own. The PR was rebase-merged after a reconciliation against main's independent rewrite of the same scaffolder (commit 80ef32f1), which had landed while the PR was open. Two open tasks, both already scoped out under a 'Follow-up (not in this change)' heading, were migrated to GitHub issues #459 and #460 rather than to a follow-up OpenSpec proposal.

decisions.title: Rebase-merge, after reconciling with main's independent rewrite
decisions.rationale: Main had independently implemented this change's core idea in 80ef32f1, extracting scaffold_change() and adding change-id validation and a status guard. Kept main's structure. Kept this branch's richer spec writer, because main writes the delta to specs/<change_id>/ while every real change under openspec/changes/ names that directory after a capability (architecture-refresh, roadmap-orchestration, skill-workflow) and one change may span several. Three of main's tests hard-coded the change-id as the directory; none was about the directory name, so they now locate the delta with rglob as two sibling tests already did.

decisions.title: Open tasks migrated to GitHub issues, not a follow-up proposal
decisions.rationale: Coordinator transport was none, so coordinator issues were unavailable. The skill's documented fallback is a follow-up OpenSpec proposal, but this repository tracks follow-ups as GitHub issues, and a 61st active change would have kept openspec.projection degraded for no benefit. Operator approved.

decisions.title: Staged rollout (Steps 5c/5d) not applicable
decisions.rationale: Those steps gate traffic promotion behind a feature flag. This change is repository tooling — a scaffolder and its tests — with no deployed surface, no traffic split and no flag to flip. Recorded as not-applicable rather than silently skipped.

next_steps: #459 disambiguate flat models.py modules, add roadmap suites to testpaths
#460 teach /plan-feature and /iterate-on-plan to replace SCAFFOLD blocks
